description: Diagnostic module for wisdom_synthesiser daemon staleness. Current age=6h7m (stale threshold=14400s per gaps map). Module must diagnose why daemon is stale without proposing rebuild (wisdom_synthesiser is not a protected file per idempotency list, but diagnostic-first approach preferred per spec Appendix A). Functions: query write_service for service_health entry, calculate heartbeat age, diagnose potential causes (crash loop, network timeout, dead process), send heartbeat if process is alive but not updating. Outputs actionable findings without touching write_service or database schema.
